card.name: Hypersensitivity and reaction terms in labels
card.fires_on: Words in or right after "hypersensitivity" (hypers-ensitive, reactions) in contraindication and warning text. Also fires on a few other label words like the end of "ARB" or "nonsteroidal".

modes.description: Part of "hypersensitive" or the word "reactions" after hypersensitivity in contraindications and warnings.
